items.name: ff-tuesdays-v3
items.text: [curious] What's money actually for? [short pause] Not the car. [warmly] This. A Tuesday morning that's all yours. [softly] No alarm. No traffic. [confident] Three hundred a month from twenty-five, at eight percent, grows to over a million by sixty-five. [warmly] Start small. Buy back your Tuesdays.

items.name: lf-warm-tea-v3
items.text: [tired] Tea number one. Reheated... twice. [sighs] Nobody claps for this part. [gently] Then one morning, the light comes in... [warmly] and you drink it warm. [softly] That counts. Small wins count.
